notes: UK-market model from Viscount Classical Organs (Bicester) on Viscount's Physis Plus platform. The MIDI scheme is taken from Viscount's Physis Plus reference manual and assumed to apply; check on your organ.
Stop names are the English specification. The organ also has Baroque, Romantic and Symphonic pipe sets plus user sets that rename and revoice the stops.
Compact 35 and 35-SV share the stop list: 2 manuals, 30-note pedalboard, Swell expression pedal, Crescendo pedal (can be set as Great/Pedal expression; not mapped).
Physis Plus uses a different default channel order from the original Physis organs (Pedal on channel 1).

Stops transmit Viscount SysEx F0 31 4n xx yy F7 (on) / F0 31 0n xx yy F7 (off), n = section channel, xx yy = internal voice ID. Voice IDs are not published for this model (and change if an alternative voice is selected), so no stop bindings are included: use Learn every stop.

Couplers are only received (F0 31 2F 70 vv F7), not transmitted; tremulant on/off is sent as tremulant speed/depth SysEx (depth 00 = off), which a stop binding cannot express. Learn or set these by hand.
all_stops_off is the documented Viscount Cancel message F0 31 2F 6C 00 F7. Expression pedals send CC11 (0-127) on the section's channel; divisional volumes send CC7 (not mapped).
Check on your organ: the channel numbers are factory defaults and can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu (a dealer may have changed them).
Stop list: https://viscountorgans.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Ensign-Compact-35.pdf (Viscount Classical Organs UK spec sheet, English Specification)
Stop list: https://viscountorgans.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Ensign-35-SV.pdf (35-SV traditional cabinet, same English specification)

MIDI scheme: https://manualslib.fr/manual/717391/Viscount-Physis-Plus-Organ-Serie.html?page=60 (Physis Plus Organ Series reference manual, Annexe 'Detailed MIDI implementation', pp. FR-58 to FR-60; official EN ed13 PDF was https://www.viscountinstruments.it/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/PhysisPlus-ReferenceManual-EN-ed13.pdf) - 2-manual defaults Pedal=ch1, Man.I/Great=ch2, Man.II/Swell=ch3, ch16 system; Register on/off F0 31 sn xx yy F7; Cancel F0 31 2F 6C 00 F7 (p. FR-60)
